Headquarters: Poland - Remote

About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

The Role

We’re looking for a Business Development Manager to grow Bybit EU’s presence in Poland and contribute to our wider European expansion. You’ll build and manage partnerships with local KOLs, affiliates, creators, crypto communities, and VIP networks—helping partners grow their audiences and delivering measurable results for Bybit.

Key Responsibilities

• 

Identify and approach potential KOLs, affiliates and crypto communities in Poland.

• 

Build and manage a strong partnership pipeline, from market mapping and outreach through negotiation, onboarding, and activation.

• 

Develop trusted relationships with existing partners and help them grow their communities and partnership performance.

• 

Create localized partnership plans and campaigns that support user acquisition, user activity, trading volume, and revenue growth.

• 

Monitor partner and campaign performance, assess ROI, and identify ways to improve results.

• 

Work with Marketing, Product, Compliance, and other internal teams to develop and deliver effective campaigns and partner initiatives.

• 

Use OSOP to create and manage Campaign 2.0 campaigns.

• 

Identify local market trends, community needs, and competitor activity, and share insights with internal teams.

• 

Promote relevant Bybit EU products as part of partner initiatives, including Bybit Pay where appropriate.

• 

Represent Bybit at local industry events and build relationships across the Polish and European crypto ecosystem.

Requirements

• 

Experience in business development, partnerships, affiliate marketing, or growth—ideally in crypto, Web3, fintech, or a digital asset exchange.

• 

A track record of acquiring and developing partnerships that contribute to user growth, trading activity, volume, or revenue.

• 

Strong knowledge of the Polish crypto market, including its KOL, affiliate, VIPs, and community landscape.

• 

A good understanding of community dynamics and the local marketing environment.

• 

Strong communication, relationship-building, pitching, and negotiation skills.

• 

Ability to use performance data to evaluate campaigns and improve partner results.

• 

Understanding of Bybit’s platform and products, or the ability to build that knowledge quickly.

• 

Awareness of the European crypto market and regulatory environment, and the ability to work with Compliance on partner initiatives.

• 

Fluency in Polish and English.

Nice to have: Familiarity with OSOP and experience creating Campaign 2.0 campaigns.

Why Join Us

At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. Our benefits include:

• 

Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.

• 

Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.

• 

Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.

• 

Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.

• 

Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bybit-eu-business-development-specialist-poland

Headquarters: United States (Remote)

Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows. 

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design. 

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.
Tines is hiring its first Paralegal to keep Legal running smoothly as we grow globally. Reporting to the Head of Legal, you'll join a lean global Legal team that includes a dedicated Legal Operations role. You'll partner with Sales, Deal Desk, Customer Success, Partnerships, Finance, Security and teams across the business to get agreements done quickly and soundly. You'll support the full range of our legal work, including commercial, partner, vendor and corporate matters. Working alongside Legal Operations, you'll handle first-pass review of agreements, contract records and obligations tracking. You'll also run the Legal team's day-to-day administration, including calendars, scheduling, travel and invoices.

What You Will Be Doing

• Partnering with Legal Operations on contract intake and prioritization, and taking standard agreements from first review through to signature.

• Doing first-pass review and redlines of customer, partner and vendor agreements, DPAs and security terms against Legal's playbooks and approved fallbacks, and escalating anything outside them to the right Legal Counsel.

• Maintaining the contract repository and key-term data, and tracking renewals, notice periods and contractual obligations.

• Running Legal team administration: coordinating meetings, outside counsel engagement letters and invoices, matter tracking and document filing.

• Keeping templates, playbooks, clause libraries and Sales enablement materials current as our products and practices change.

• Working with Legal Operations to improve Legal workflows and automations, including in Tines itself.

• Supporting broader Legal team projects as needed.

What You Will Bring

• Paralegal certificate or bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of legal experience, including 3+ years as a paralegal, ideally supporting commercial, technology or corporate work in-house or at a law firm.

• A strong understanding of the legal issues affecting SaaS and software transactions.

• Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace. Experience with DocuSign and Notion is a plus.

• Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

• Proven ability to manage many matters at once and meet deadlines.

• Comfort owning administrative work, including calendar management, scheduling, travel and invoices, alongside substantive contract work.

• Alignment with Tines’ values of speed, simplicity, and soundness.

Experience That Would Be Helpful

• Previous in-house experience at a SaaS, software, cybersecurity, or other technology company.

• Experience supporting commercial teams across EMEA and the United States.

• Familiarity with AI products and the commercial, privacy, and intellectual property issues that arise when customers use them.

Target Annual Compensation: $100k - $115k salary + equity

A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are. We’d love to hear from you.

About Abacum

Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

We are looking for...
An enterprise seller who already knows the Office of the CFO. You've carried a number selling planning, EPM, FP&A or finance software. You know how a CFO buys, how a steering committee stalls, and how to get a multi-stakeholder deal signed.
At Abacum you'll own a named territory of enterprise and upper mid-market accounts across EMEA. Many of them run legacy planning tools or spreadsheets that can't keep up with the business. Your job is to show them a better foundation, and win.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will...
- Own the full sales cycle for a named book of enterprise accounts, from first meeting to signed contract
- Build and run your own pipeline through targeted outbound, events, and partner co-selling with ERP vendors and implementation partners
- Sell to CFOs, VPs of Finance and Heads of FP&A, and bring IT, procurement, security and legal along the way
- Run complex evaluations: discovery, business cases, proofs of concept, and competitive displacements
- Forecast with discipline and keep a clean pipeline in CRM
- Work with Solutions Engineering, Product and Leadership to shape deals, and feed what you hear in the market back into the roadmap

What we need...
- 6+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales, with at least 3 years closing enterprise deals
- Experience selling EPM, FP&A, planning, or other Office-of-the-CFO software (finance, ERP, spend, or data platforms)
- A track record of closing six-figure ARR deals with 3–6 month cycles and hitting or beating quota
- Comfort leading multi-stakeholder deals with finance, IT, procurement and security at the table
- Experience displacing an incumbent, whether a legacy system or a spreadsheet-based process
- A consultative, value-based approach: you build a business case in a CFO's language
- The drive to build your own pipeline, not wait for inbound
- Clear, sharp written and verbal communication, including running demos with senior buyers
- Based in EMEA, with the ability to travel to customers and events

Bonus points if you have...
- Sold with or through ERP ecosystems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics) or implementation partners
- Worked in finance, or you're comfortable talking models, drivers and variances with an FP&A team
- Used a structured sales method (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or similar)
- Been an early seller at a scaling company and helped build the enterprise playbook

Why sell Abacum
You know the category. Here's why this is the product you want in your bag.
1. A market ready to switch. Finance teams are stuck between rigid legacy planning tools that need a rebuild every time the business changes, and spreadsheets and AI tools no one can trust. Abacum is the governed, AI-native foundation that fixes both. That's a displacement story you can tell in every account.
2. AI that stands up to a CFO. Plenty of vendors claim AI. Ours runs on a governed financial model, so the AI reasons and the math stays exact. CFOs and IT teams can trust the output, and that wins technical evaluations.
3. Faster time to value than legacy EPM. 700+ integrations and self-service data pipelines mean customers see value in weeks, not after a long implementation. That shortens your cycle and makes the business case easy to sign.
4. Channels that bring you deals. Abacum is the only FP&A platform to pass NetSuite's SuiteCloud Developer Network review, is listed on the Sage Intacct Marketplace, and is a verified Microsoft Dynamics 365 partner. Those ecosystems and our implementation partners mean co-sell pipeline, not just cold outbound.
5. A product that keeps getting stronger. New AI skills ship every week. Abacum works where finance already works: Excel, Slack, Claude and ChatGPT, through MCP-native infrastructure. You'll have something new to show every quarter.
6. Funded to win enterprise. Abacum raised a $60M Series B to scale into larger customers. You'll join as we build the enterprise motion, with the room to shape it and grow with it.

What you get
- Competitive base, uncapped commission, and equity
- Remote in EMEA, with hubs in New York, Toronto and Barcelona
- Direct access to leadership and a real say in how we sell to enterprise

Benefits
• 
Competitive compensation including equity package
• 
Competitive vacation policy
• 
Medical Insurance
• 
L&D budget
• 
Access to Meditopia (wellbeing platform)
• 
Language courses (English / Spanish)

Our Values

Customer Obsession: Our purpose is to create value for the finance teams we serve. We pour our energy into driving impact for them fast, and we measure our success by theirs.

Relentless Ambition: We chose to compete at the top alongside the best. We set ambitious goals, and keep pushing when it gets hard. Nothing worth having comes easy.

One Team: There is no “they” at Abacum: “their” problem is our problem. We’re candid because we care, we help each other grow, and we embrace different perspectives.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

About the team

Would you like to be part of creating a unicorn within a unicorn? Solve some of the biggest challenges facing the financial inclusion of Bharat? Well, then here’s your chance! Financial Services (FS) is one of the fastest growing new businesses at Meesho. It's a large 10X opportunity for Meesho to build financial products for Bharat users and serve the unmet needs of millions of our users. And you will be at the center of this journey, building and scaling the business and serving millions of Meesho users. Meesho FS has several lines of products primarily in lending space for users and sellers of Meesho.

We aspire to create one of the country’s largest financial services businesses, drawing inspiration from global giants such as Alibaba, Shopee, and Mercado Libre, who have thrived in markets comparable to India and built large financial businesses.

About the Role

In this role, you will own the growth and governance of Meesho's Bank and NBFC partnerships across lending. Your first priority will be to scale existing partnerships by improving funnel performance, monitoring portfolio and risk, and deepening partner relationships. You will also lead new-partner integrations end to end, establish standard and increasingly automated operating processes, and build a qualified pipeline of new partners aligned with the supply roadmap. The role requires close collaboration with growth, credit risk, collections, product, technology, legal, compliance, finance, and operations teams to deliver timely launches and stable scale-up.


What you will do
• Own and grow existing Bank and NBFC partnerships by managing joint business plans, supply, funnel performance, and conversion, and by driving initiatives that increase disbursals and assets under management.

• Build deep relationships and strong governance with partner stakeholders across senior and working teams. Maintain regular engagement, understand strategic, policy, risk, and operational developments and provide timely internal and external updates.

• Track portfolio performance, funnel metrics, policy adherence, risk indicators, and operational health for each partner. Identify growth opportunities and emerging issues, and work with credit, growth, product, collections, and operations teams to improve the funnel and drive corrective actions.

• Lead new-partner integrations end to end, covering policy, commercial, legal, compliance, information-security, and tech construct alignment; UAT; launch; and post-go-live stability. Maintain clear owners, dependencies, milestones, and escalation paths so all teams deliver against a common timeline.

• Standardise and automate the partner integration and management playbook, including documentation, project trackers, governance forums, handoffs, and escalation processes, to reduce manual intervention and make execution faster and more predictable.

• Build a qualified pipeline of new Banks and NBFCs aligned with the supply roadmap and product and policy needs. Evaluate strategic fit, economics, risk appetite, and execution readiness, and drive the right partners from pitch and structuring through commercial and legal closure, onboarding, and launch.

• Executive communication: Write exec-level documents and present results and findings to senior management

What you will need
• 2-3 years of experience managing Bank and NBFC partnerships, preferably in a fintech or NBFC

• Good understanding of co-lending models, FLDG structures, and DLG guidelines

• Strong negotiation, communication, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to build trust across senior and working-level stakeholders and identify partner developments early

• Strong analytical ability to monitor partner funnels, portfolio performance, and risk metrics, and translate insights into growth initiatives or corrective actions

• High ownership, analytical skills, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

• Demonstrated execution and program-management experience, including driving cross-functional integrations or other high-impact projects through launch and post-go-live stability

• Strong growth mindset and an inquisitive mindset, continuous problem solving to improve and grow the business

• Ability to independently drive problem statements and impact. Understand business needs and come up with right pitch and communication strategies

• First principles based critical thinking and data-led approach to problem-solving

What you will get
• A rare opportunity to build a large scale financial services business for millions of users

• Collaborate and drive growth of some of the latest fintech products and innovations

• End to end responsibility and ownership

• Once in a lifetime opportunity to create impact at scale

• Strong employee-friendly policies

• A fun and supportive team and leadership
